prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Paint ONE flat ground-material swatch for the isometric railway game Terepasztal, requested canvas 1024x1024 px, real PNG fully opaque. Four attached images are references only: 1 theme town-growth board for palette and quiet painted house style; 2 approved rock-surface for rock family and ground swatch concept; 3 terrain-mountain for rock and snow HUE ONLY, never its blocky pixels or mountain shape; 4 land-biomes Mountain and Taiga snow for MOOD ONLY, never its pixel art or tile shape.
Geometry: fill the entire square evenly to every edge with flat ground, screen-aligned as an orthographic 2:1 isometric camera sees flat ground from 30 degrees down. There is NO tile shape. Square spans about three tiles across: one tile at source is about 330x165 px; a stone one tenth tile across is about 33 px. Tile offset (x,y) maps to (512+165*(x-y),512+82.5*(x+y)); these numbers explain scale only, draw no guide.
Style: smooth painted contours, broad coherent colour clusters, three or four main shades per material, crisp restrained illustration, no stair-stepped pixel edges, no per-pixel noise or photographic grain. One fixed upper-left light. Scenery stays quiet behind rails. No bright cyan (#66CCD6), amber selection (#E8AA48), or cursor white: no colour as bright as #ECE4D0. Palette context forest #294638, moss #78804C, oat #E4D5B5, limestone #BCA98B, slate #626B6C, water #477B82, copper #A36B42.
Never diamond, tile edges, borders, horizon, perspective depth, peaks, silhouettes, standing outcrops, cast shadows, central motif, identical repeated shapes, long parallel lines, trees, people, footprints, text or glow. Material only, no finished game piece. Edge seamlessness desirable but no mirrored repetition. Features should read when the square is reduced to about 199 px wide.
MATERIAL: Wind-packed snow ONLY with no rock or ground showing through. Broad soft shallow drifts, a few short broken curved ripple marks each UNDER 82 source pixels (quarter tile), irregularly scattered never in rows, small soft blue-grey shadow pockets. Brightest #DCE1E4, body #C9D1D6, shadows #A6B2BC. Desaturated, low detail, soft and quiet, NOT a terrain scene or dune ridges.
